Name: Lumisteria Giant Crops for Sunberry Village
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod adds 3 giant crops for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url].
You can now get giant crops for :
- Calla Lilies
- Coffee Blossom
- Cyclamen

Unlike vanilla crops, those will require a pattern of 3*2 to have a chance to appear, aka :
XXX
XXX
Since this pattern is more flexible, they have a default chance that is, by default, lower than classic giant crops. This can be configured for each crop.

I suggest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14370]Giant Crop Tweaks[/url] if you want those crops to be able to appears everywhere, including Ginger Island.

Thanks Skellady for the permission to make the mod.
Thanks AirynS for the base cyclamen crop.
Thanks Taiyou for the base calla lilies and coffee blossom crops.
